description: Add a credit (role + name) to a film's credit list, optionally linking it to a Vidreno filmmaker by username (they get a request to accept) or inviting the person by email (the invite is sent straight away; at most 60 credits per film, invites are rate-limited per day). Returns the full credit list with credit_ids.

email.description: Invite the person by email instead: the credit is stored and an invite email is sent now.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

name.description: The person's name as it should appear.

position.description: 1-based position in the credit list; default last.

role.description: The role, e.g. Director, Editor, Lead actor.

username.description: Link the credit to an existing Vidreno filmmaker account by username (they are asked to accept).

name: add_film_credit
title: Add a credit
